objective.name: pilot_message
objective.description: Defines an addressed message emitted by a pilot, containing the destination, semantic kind, payload, and optional correlation before durable message metadata is assigned.

functional._to_note: Required. Explicit destination of the message.
functional._kind_note: Required. High-level semantic category of the message requested by the pilot.
functional._correlation_note: Optional. Correlation data to preserve causal or continuity relationships when the runtime materializes the durable message.
